# dokploy_patch (Resource)

A file change that Dokploy applies to the repository of an application or a compose service before each build: it creates, replaces, or deletes one file. A change applies at the next deploy.

~> Each file path can have one patch for each service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Replace a file in the repository of an application before each build.
resource "dokploy_patch" "config" {
  application_id = dokploy_application.web.id
  file_path      = "config/app.yaml"
  content        = file("${path.module}/app.yaml")
}

# Remove a file from the repository of a compose service before each build.
resource "dokploy_patch" "no_override" {
  compose_id = dokploy_compose.stack.id
  file_path  = "docker-compose.override.yml"
  type       = "delete"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_path` (String) Path of the file, relative to the repository root, for example `config/app.yaml`.

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Id of the application whose repository the patch changes. Set exactly one of `application_id` or `compose_id`. A change replaces the patch.
- `compose_id` (String) Id of the compose service whose repository the patch changes. Set exactly one of `application_id` or `compose_id`. A change replaces the patch.
- `content` (String) Full content of the file. Defaults to `""`, the value for a `delete` patch. Dokploy adds a final newline to a non-empty content when it updates the patch.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Apply the patch at the next build. Defaults to `true`.
- `type` (String) What the patch does to the file: `create` adds it, `update` replaces its content, and `delete` removes it. Defaults to `update`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from the server.
- `id` (String) Patch id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dokploy_patch.config
  id = "5lKDN_oX5hVG5balpQIKv"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import dokploy_patch.config 5lKDN_oX5hVG5balpQIKv
```
